fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-06-14 (night, 21:55): The compound wall of the complainant near Mangai Colony Railway Station Road was defaced and partly broken. The complainant, Jagan Shankar, provided the contact number 9000000161. A further person, Hariharan Subramani, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000044, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant alleged that Karthik Thangaraj may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000053. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00087, as the mobile number 9000000053 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Unidentified persons allegedly damaged the property while it was unattended.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, mobile number, suspect, CCTV, night, railway station road, associate
